name: Instrument of Scribing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Play

params.text: writes a short message on an object

powers.text: It writes a short message on an object. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 3 charges: write a magical message on an object by playing.
text: The instrument holds 3 charges. While playing it, spend 1 charge as a Magic action to inscribe a magical message onto any nonmagical object or surface within 30 feet that you can see. (It has no further use in the game.)
